query: InfiniteTalk/MultiTalk crashes at multitalk.py:247 reshape (tensor size mismatch) after updating to ComfyUI 0.19.x; suspected off-by-one frame count. Anyone running 800x456 (non-16-divisible resolution) hits it.

desired.outcome: OP confirmed root cause was resolution: 800x456 is not divisible by 16 (456/16=28.5), causing the audio cross-attention reshape mismatch; switching to 832x480 in ImageScaleByAspectRatio fixed it completely (OP comment 'rookie-thomas'). Corroborated by Booyaka101's clean repro on current main and maintainer (kijai) saying the example workflow runs unchanged.
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies the correct root cause; fix actionable and directionally correct.

_tags.hidden_requirement: Tests whether the solver connects an audio cross-attention reshape mismatch to a resolution not divisible by 16 (456/16=28.5) and fixes it at the resize node
